name: cider
description: Apple MCP server for Calendar, Notes, and Contacts on macOS

scripts.build:swift: mkdir -p src/helpers/CiderCalendarHelper.app/Contents/MacOS && swiftc -O src/helpers/cider-cal.swift -o src/helpers/CiderCalendarHelper.app/Contents/MacOS/cider-cal && cp src/helpers/cider-cal.Info.plist src/helpers/CiderCalendarHelper.app/Contents/Info.plist && codesign --force --sign - --options runtime --entitlements src/helpers/cider-cal.entitlements src/helpers/CiderCalendarHelper.app
